# Tari Counter

Rust/WASM template: owner-authorized writes, public reads and rollback tests.

Pinned dependencies: tari_template_lib 0.32.0 and tari_template_test_tooling 0.41.0.

Run `cargo test --locked` then `cargo build --locked --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown`.

Use the Tari tools panel to connect your local companion. Local builds do not deploy or publish.

Source: https://github.com/marguerite347/ootle-lobby-community/tree/d44f4aa/creator-hub/skills/examples/counter
Official reference: https://ootle.tari.com/
